business_facts: Rooms are booked only through the facilities coordinator.
External invitees require the calendar owner's approval.
Recurring meetings keep a stable room unless the owner changes it.
Meeting notes are delivered as briefs, never raw agendas.
The verified primary schedule is Tuesday 10:00 in Room C.
Approval decisions follow the documented policy: exceptions may be accepted when the named owner approves them and the decision records a business justification and a rollback plan.
